description: Schema for extracting key information from an invoice document.

invoice_number.description: The unique identifier for the invoice.

issue_date.description: The date when the invoice was issued.

due_date.description: The date by which the invoice payment is due.

vendor.description: Information about the vendor, seller, or supplier.

address.description: The full address of the vendor.

email.description: The email address of the vendor.

customer.description: Information about the customer or the entity being billed.

address.description: The full billing address of the customer.

line_items.description: A list of individual items or services detailed in the invoice.

description.description: A description of the item or service.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item or service.

unit_price.description: The price per unit of the item or service.

amount.description: The total amount for this line item (quantity * unit_price).

summary_totals.description: Summary of all financial totals on the invoice.

subtotal.description: The sum of all line item amounts before taxes and discounts.

tax_rate.description: The tax rate applied, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.08875 for 8.875%).

tax_amount.description: The total amount of tax applied to the invoice.

grand_total.description: The final total amount due for the invoice, including all taxes and charges.

payment_terms.description: The terms and conditions for payment, e.g., 'Net 30'.
